svg.title: How the models share the machine
svg.desc: Timeline: Chandra OCR 2 on the GPU (llama-server 9999) reads pages with 1 or 2 workers; the app's code gates pages, extracts NĐ30 fields and saves to SQLite; bge-m3 embeds passages. For a question: bge-m3 embeds it, FTS5 matches words, ViRanker on CPU rescores, Qwen3-8B on the GPU (llama-server 9998) writes the answer, and the app checks it in about 2 ms. Rules: 10 GB of VRAM or more runs Qwen3-8B, 5 GB or more Qwen3-4B on GPU, less runs Qwen3-4B on CPU with an 8k context. OCR workers: CPU 1, GPU under 16 GB 1, from 16 GB 2, from 48 GB 4.
